description: FS-GG org-shared Renovate preset (FS-GG/.github#22, epic #16 Pillar 4). Custom managers for EVERY embedded cross-repo pin that the standard managers miss — the fs-gg-ui template pin (FsGgUiVersion MSBuild property), the FS.GG.Governance gate-set pin, and any literal annotated with a `renovate:` comment — resolved from the org GitHub Packages NuGet feed. The standard `nuget` manager already covers <PackageReference>/<PackageVersion> (FS.GG.Contracts and friends). Consume from a product repo with: "extends": ["github>FS-GG/.github"]. DORMANT until org-admin provisions the GitHub Packages feed + the Renovate app install (FS-GG/.github#21): the feed URL is deterministic from the org login, but private-feed auth comes from that install.

packageRules.description: All FS.GG.* packages resolve from the org GitHub Packages NuGet feed.
The fs-gg-ui coherent set moves as one — group FS.GG.UI.* (members + BOM + template) into a single PR.
FS-GG packages ship on a -preview channel; track prereleases instead of pinning to a non-existent stable.

customManagers.description: fs-gg-ui template pin: the FsGgUiVersion MSBuild property → FS.GG.UI.Template (the published coherent-set version).

Generic annotation-driven manager: any embedded pin tagged `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<pkg> [versioning=<v>]` on the line(s) above the version literal. Used for the FS.GG.Governance gate-set pin and any other non-standard embedded literal across repos.

hostRules.description: Auth for the org GitHub Packages NuGet feed (private; FS.GG.* are not on nuget.org). The token is the read:packages PAT uploaded as the org-level Mend App Secret FSGG_PACKAGES_READ_TOKEN (Mend-hosted apps no longer support config-based encrypted secrets — secrets are UI-uploaded and referenced by name). Provisioned under FS-GG/.github#21.
